blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No bettor won the jackpots in the three major lotto games drawn Tuesday, Sept. 29, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO). The Ultra Lotto 6/58 winning combination was 12-20-31-55-38-18 for a jackpot of ₱344.76 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. The Super Lotto 6/49 winning combination was 27-16-41-02-39-20 for a jackpot of ₱27.79 million. There was no jackpot winner.
